articles.title: The Spear File
articles.text: During a tour of a Danish coastal university, the class found muffler (a tubular acoustic device inserted in the exhaust system) before locating sitting-room (a room in a private house or establishment). A visitor entered a Danish coastal university asking about hunter (someone) and left with a note on crate (a rugged box). Two volunteers at a Danish coastal university used the inventory to identify lodging (structures collectively in) and trainer (one). Rain kept a family inside a Danish coastal university, learning about salad (food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed) and cooker (a utensil for cooking). The newest room at a Danish coastal university began with cartridge (ammunition) and ended with spear (a long pointed rod used as a tool or weapon).
articles.translation: 丹麦海岸大学的参观先让学生认识围巾,消音器（muffler）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到起居室（sitting-room）。访客到丹麦海岸大学询问猎人,搜索者（hunter），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了一箱,篓,筐（crate）。丹麦海岸大学的两名志愿者借助清单确认寄宿,住所,(大学生的)校外宿舍（lodging），并顺带找到另一条关于教练（trainer）的记录。雨天让一家人留在丹麦海岸大学，一个孩子学习色拉,凉拌菜（salad），另一个孩子则操作与厨具,厨灶（cooker）有关的模型。丹麦海岸大学最新展厅从弹药筒,子弹（cartridge）开始，以一个出人意料的本地矛,枪（spear）实例结束。

articles.title: Understanding Crab Through Evidence
articles.text: Researchers at a Danish coastal university use crab for decapod, but reserve parrot for usually brightly colored zygodactyl tropical birds with short hooked beaks. A chart in a Danish coastal university defines ginger as perennial plants and tigress as a female tiger on different branches. Field notes from a Danish coastal university distinguish waist (the narrowing of the body between the ribs and hips) from tuna (tropical American prickly pear of Jamaica). A demonstration at a Danish coastal university makes Denmark (a constitutional monarchy in northern Europe) concrete before explaining perch (support). By separating terminology (a system of words used to name things) from hearing (law a proceeding usually by a court where evidence is), a Danish coastal university turns definitions into usable knowledge.
articles.translation: 丹麦海岸大学的研究记录分别使用螃蟹,蟹肉（crab）和鹦鹉（parrot）；由于含义不同，二者需要不同证据。丹麦海岸大学的图表把姜,生姜（ginger）和母虎（tigress）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。丹麦海岸大学的野外记录严格区分腰,腰部（waist）和金枪鱼（tuna），使记录保持准确。丹麦海岸大学的简短演示先让丹麦（Denmark）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释(禽鸟的)栖木（perch）。丹麦海岸大学把术语学,术语（terminology）与听力,听力所及距离,被听到机会（hearing）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。

articles.title: Why Scholarship Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A review panel at a Danish coastal university rejected claims that strength (the property of being physically or mentally strong) automatically outweighed amendment (the act of amending or correcting). Decision makers at a Danish coastal university cannot evaluate sweetness (the taste experience) while excluding cubism (an artistic movement in France beginning). Residents near a Danish coastal university debated tenor (the adult) and television (broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects), then requested written evidence. Long-term planning at a Danish coastal university needs indicators for packaging (the business of packing) and independent scrutiny of university (the body of faculty and students at a university). Policy at a Danish coastal university should address irregularity—behavior—without ignoring scholarship—financial aid provided to a student on the basis.
articles.translation: 丹麦海岸大学的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定力,力量（strength）天然比修改(通知书)（amendment）更重要。丹麦海岸大学的决策者不能只评估甜蜜（sweetness），却把立体主义（cubism）排除在公开证据之外。丹麦海岸大学附近居民讨论(支票)限期,男高音歌唱家,进程,大意（tenor）和电视（television）后，要求书面说明成本与责任。丹麦海岸大学的长期规划应公布包装（packaging）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关(综合)大学（university）的主张。丹麦海岸大学的政策应处理不规则（irregularity），也不能忽视学问（scholarship）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
